stem: Similar feeding damage is concentrated on plants nearest an air intake. What should the technician do?
choices: Assume the entire room has uniform pressure
Map the edge/intake-associated pattern, inspect relevant signs/traps, and report the localized finding
Move affected leaves to propagation for comparison
Ignore the pattern because location is not useful
rationale: Spatial patterns can narrow investigation. An intake-associated cluster should be recorded as a pattern rather than generalized to the whole room.
